collection.title: BMW 2 Series Coupe/Gran Coupe 2019 to 2021 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A BMW 2 Series Coupe 2019 Onwards requires a 26" wiper blade the drivers side and a 17" on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses a one of a kind BMW Specific Fit wiper arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
